scientific_integrity: The monomial automorphism theorem, general group realization and orbit-isomorphism counting are credited to existing literature; proofs and finite computations are distinguished. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniformly sampled invertible labelled matrices over the two-element field; not uniformly sampled isomorphism classes, nor larger finite fields. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Sharp generic automorphism rigidity for binary perfect evolution algebras
